model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between training and validation set quantities and accuracy across five categories. The horizontal axis lists the categories:实体识别 (Entity Recognition), 角色识别 (Role Recognition), 异常识别 (Anomaly Recognition), 空间推理 (Spatial Reasoning), and 同义识别 (Synonym Recognition), while the vertical axis on the left side represents the quantity, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1200, and the right side shows the accuracy, with a linear scale from 0 to 1. The blue bars represent the training set quantities, with values of approximately 1102, 1095, 1077, 1210, and 5, respectively. The orange bars indicate the validation set quantities, with values of approximately 250, 190, 40, 675, and 55, respectively. A gray line depicts the accuracy, with values of approximately 0.7666, 0.8714, 0.692, 0.2852, and 0.3769, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
